say:0:1536022001:0.text: I know the recipe, they're simple enough to make.
say:0:1536022001:0.source_cn: 呼临叶饼……我知道这种食物的配方，做起来并不麻烦。
say:0:1536022001:0.male: I know the recipe, they're simple enough to make.
say:0:1536022001:0.female: I know the recipe, they're simple enough to make.

say:1:1536022002:0.text: Maybe I'll cook some for this starving soul, if I have the time.
say:1:1536022002:0.source_cn: 有时间的话，或许可以试着给这个饿昏的人做一些吃。
